name: schema_first
sql: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_catalog='frozen' AND table_name IN ('nodes','edges','inventory','sources','spans') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position

rows.data_type: STRUCT(kind VARCHAR, renamed_from STRUCT(kind VARCHAR, file STRUCT(path VARCHAR, "encoding" VARCHAR, bytes VARCHAR), symbol STRUCT(stable_symbol_id VARCHAR, "commit" VARCHAR)))

name: runtime
sql: SELECT version() AS version

name: row_conservation
sql: SELECT count(*) AS calls,count(DISTINCT (logical_path,edge_id)) AS unique_calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE target_node_id IS NULL) AS unresolved,count(*) FILTER(WHERE package IS NULL) AS package_unknown FROM features

name: file_candidate_multiplicity
sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN file_candidates=0 THEN 'zero' WHEN file_candidates=1 THEN 'one' ELSE 'multiple' END AS multiplicity,
count(*) AS sites,sum(file_candidates) AS candidate_pairs FROM features WHERE target_node_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: package_candidate_multiplicity
sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN package_candidates=0 THEN 'zero' WHEN package_candidates=1 THEN 'one' ELSE 'multiple' END AS multiplicity,
count(*) AS sites,sum(package_candidates) AS candidate_pairs FROM features WHERE target_node_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: global_candidate_multiplicity
sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN global_candidates=0 THEN 'zero' WHEN global_candidates=1 THEN 'one' ELSE 'multiple' END AS multiplicity,
count(*) AS sites,sum(global_candidates) AS candidate_pairs FROM features WHERE target_node_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: evidence_partition
sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN target_label LIKE '%::%' THEN 'qualified_target_label'
WHEN scope_text IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(scope_text))>0 THEN 'scope_text_without_qualified_label'
WHEN receiver_text IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(receiver_text))>0 THEN 'receiver_without_scope_or_qualified_label'
ELSE 'bare_without_receiver_or_scope' END AS evidence,count(*) AS sites FROM features WHERE target_node_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: scope_top_30
sql: SELECT scope_text,count(*) AS sites FROM features WHERE target_node_id IS NULL AND scope_text IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sites DESC,scope_text LIMIT 30

name: name_join_fanout
sql: SELECT count(*) AS input_sites,count(*) FILTER(WHERE global_candidates=0) AS dropped_by_inner_join,sum(global_candidates) AS candidate_pairs,max(global_candidates) AS maximum_fanout FROM features WHERE target_node_id IS NULL

name: no_candidate_top_20
sql: SELECT target_label,count(*) AS sites FROM features WHERE target_node_id IS NULL AND global_candidates=0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sites DESC,target_label LIMIT 20

name: single_candidate_with_receiver
sql: SELECT count(*) AS sites FROM features WHERE target_node_id IS NULL AND global_candidates=1 AND receiver_text IS NOT NULL

name: package_coverage
sql: SELECT package,count(*) AS files FROM package_paths GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY package

name: source_examples
sql:
WITH ranked AS (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY
CASE WHEN global_candidates=0 THEN 'zero' WHEN global_candidates=1 THEN 'one' ELSE 'multiple' END,
CASE WHEN target_label LIKE '%::%' THEN 'qualified' WHEN scope_text IS NOT NULL THEN 'scope' WHEN receiver_text IS NOT NULL THEN 'receiver' ELSE 'bare' END
ORDER BY logical_path,edge_id) AS rn FROM features WHERE target_node_id IS NULL)
SELECT e.logical_path,e.edge_id,e.target_label,e.receiver_text,e.scope_text,e.package,e.file_candidates,e.package_candidates,e.global_candidates,
n.label AS caller,p.start_line,p.end_line,
substring(hex(s.source_bytes),2*CAST(p.start_byte AS BIGINT)+1,2*CAST(least(p.end_byte-p.start_byte,6000) AS BIGINT)) AS caller_source_hex
FROM ranked e LEFT JOIN frozen.main.nodes n ON n.logical_path=e.logical_path AND n.node_id=e.source_node_id
LEFT JOIN frozen.main.spans p ON p.logical_path=n.logical_path AND p.span_id=n.source_span_id
LEFT JOIN frozen.main.sources s ON s.logical_path=e.logical_path WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY e.logical_path,e.edge_id
